verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's own docs describe an MCP Gateway: users add MCP servers through the UI ('Add New MCP Server'), all their tools are exposed behind one fixed endpoint, and tools can be listed and called via REST, so the product connects to and uses MCP server tools. missing for 10: detailed docs on supported transports and setup, explicit evidence that model completions invoke MCP tools in an agent loop, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: LiteLLM Proxy provides an MCP Gateway that allows you to use a fixed endpoint for all MCP tools and control MCP access by Key, Team.
On the LiteLLM UI, Navigate to "MCP Servers" and click "Add New MCP Server".
call tools with curl without an LLM
